# Introduction {-}
This book presents analytical workflows taking the raw data and processing them up to the final results reported in the manuscript. The dedicated functions and data sets were compiled into [`sangchem`](https://github.com/TomVuod/sangchem) [`R package`](https://www.r-project.org/) which is available on GitHub and can be installed using the following command:
```{r eval=FALSE}
if(!require(devtools)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("TomVuod/sangchem")
```
